profile.headline: Software Development Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS)
profile.summary: Hi I'm Eric. I build stuff.

positions.title: Front End Engineering Intern
positions.description:
● Worked on Search Product Team to improve the Facebook search experience on desktop and mobile sites. 
● Built full-stack modules following prototypes by UX experts and gave design feedback

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
● Implemented an intuitive interface for Akamai Field Technicians to check the general health of deployed hardware after maintenance to increase the number of maintenance tickets handled
● Designed, implemented and test front-end and back-end (Wrapper API) of this feature in Agile development environment
● Utilized frameworks like Spring & AngularJS to build a RESTful API wrapper and web app that adhere to best practices

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
● Developed an android companion app for Jogcall, a persuasive system for couples to jog together
● App communicates via Bluetooth & Wifi with Arduino sensors around the house to track couple’s activities

positions.title: Grader
positions.description: ● Graded, beta-tested and provided feedback on problem sets for Intro to EECS 2

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
● Built python-based scalable infrastructure to analyze millions of recorded chess games with top UCI chess engines to be deployed on a cloud cluster
● Contrived and implemented statistical framework that enables chess researchers to carry out statistically confident studies on chess

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Tutored Intro to Electrical Engineering and Computer Science I under HKN and MIT Maseeh Hall.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description: Responded to an average of 15 reference questions a day. Performed basic circulation duties and enforced policies to maintain a safe and comfortable learning environment.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
● Designed social media platform as a web application to document student-led iLab development projects and leveraged different WordPress toolkits to support this
● Provided day-to-day management of web site and published ongoing information on projects

company.name: MIT Center for Educational Computing Initiatives

positions.title: MIT Socio-technical Systems Research Center
positions.description:

● Entrusted with sensitive and confidential information and held responsible for a significant segment of the team 
project

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
● Communicated with an average of 100 MTN Mobile Money foot-soldiers a day
● Collected and compiled information to investigate inconsistencies with information in MTN’s system
● Streamlined the foot-soldier certification process and provided technical assistance when necessary

positions.description: Optimized and analyzed Turtle Art (Visual/graphical programming tool) on the Sugar OS. Added debugging tools which reduced user error by ~40%

organizations.name: CODE2040
organizations.description: CODE2040 is a nonprofit organization that creates pathways to educational, professional, and entrepreneurial success in technology for underrepresented minorities with a specific focus on Blacks and Latino/as.

organizations.name: Eta Kappa Nu Honor Society
organizations.description: Eta Kappa Nu is the national honor society for Electrical Engineering and Computer science. At MIT, HKN is primarily interested in improving course VI by providing students with many helpful resources. These resources include the Underground guide to course VI and VI-A, the HKN tutoring program, and many social events.
